verdict.rationale: The pack lists a first-party Bits AI assistant page and a documented official Datadog MCP Server, which implies AI agents can query telemetry conversationally. A ChatGPT plugin for analyzing experiments points the same way. But the evidence is title-level only and never describes typing a natural-language question and getting back a generated query or chart. Missing for 10: documented NL-to-query/chart generation in Bits AI, detail on what the MCP server returns (queries, metrics, visualizations), hands-on or independent corroboration.
